There are others!?

secret paths, this one is
relatively safe to use at this
time of year.
Eu! Once we get back, I'm\nabsolutely destroying this path!

circumstances, you are now
"escaped convicts who fled

WHAAAAAT!?

safe." I never said it was
completely without danger.
Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaat!?

strange noises, you've got a
keen nose! There aren't many

ferocious creatures living in

Rubarika soldiers exactly
where we are. Show some
restraint.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font>: ...Welch. Calm down.
Fine. I'll do as you say for now.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Hey, Eu-boy!
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Welch, be quiet. We'll be\nfound again.

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> That masked man called

Rakstar, as in Lord Carlone's

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> You should be more

sake, and for the sake of your

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Once we cross the
border on this road, the first
place we'll reach is a village
called <font color=yellow>Korurine</font>.

Baschen's army has a decent
number of troops stationed
there, so I think we can take a
breather once we arrive.
Until then, please keep that\npowder keg of a girl quiet.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> GAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!

<font color=blue>Verda</font> So this is Korurine. From
the looks of it, the cultural
style isn't all that different
from Rubarika.

Karlyn's outfit is so unique that
I thought we'd be entering a
completely different cultural
sphere.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> You use some awfully\nsophisticated language for\nsomeone your age.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Family circumstances.

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> I see. Women from
Rubarika seem to become
more childlike the larger they
get.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Hmph! Now hold on a\nsecond... that was a total dig\nat me, wasn't it?!
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Oh, so you do have\nenough brainpower to\nunderstand sarcasm.

<font color=blue>Welch</font> How dare you say that
to the most brilliant and
beautiful girl in Rubarika, you
witch!
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> ...Welch. That's enough.
We're in enemy territory. For all\nintents and purposes, we're\nKarlyn's prisoners.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Besides, we aren't\nRubarikans. We're a troupe of\nwandering performers.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> So that's why her voice\nsounds so strange sometimes.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> ...Good luck, Captain.

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> I thought you were a
strange bunch, but I never
would have guessed you were
traveling performers.
Come to think of it, I don't\neven know your names.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> Oh, that's right! We\nhaven't properly introduced\nourselves yet!
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Hmm. And you're\n<player>, right?
As for why you're called\n"Captain," I'll let you explain\nthat in due time.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> I'm Tika. Tika Blanche.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> I be Verda Kleiman. We\nbe part of a troupe called\n"Coro's Ship."
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Ah, so that's why you're\nthe "Captain."
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> I'm Euwin. Euwin Laxter.
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> ...Evelysse.

It's not as if we're in a position
to want to be friends, so
knowing each other's names is
enough.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> ...My apologies.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Eu-boy. Why are you\napologizing?
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> ...Right now, we're the\nones being rude.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> ...Eu-boy, you!!
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> I understand how you\nfeel, Welch.

But please, judge the situation
calmly. There is absolutely
nothing to be gained by
snapping at Ms. Karlyn right
now.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> ...!!

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Well then, for now, let's
seek protection from the
Korurine garrison. My

I have a promise to keep with
that insufferable masked man,

to die, so I'll make sure you're

en: W-what is this...?
...The masked man told us.

He said it was public
knowledge that Karlyn had
been captured by Rubarika. I'm
sure the word reached
Korurine too.
Even so, why is everyone so\nwelcoming...?
The "Beast Witch," known even\nto our enemy, Rubarika.

Put another way, to the people
of Baschen, she is a reliable
ally who protects the village
and crushes the enemy.
...This is ridiculous.
Tika, what's wrong?
...They look the same.
What does?
The look on the faces of the\npeople from Dagris when Big\nBrother Euwin saved them...
Thank you, everyone. I'm glad\nto be alive and well.
The rumors that I was\ncaptured by Rubarika are\ncompletely false.
Right now, I'm on an escort\nmission to bring these people\nto Commander Giverese.
Rest assured, we Beast\nWitches will definitely stop the\nRubarika army's invasion.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Commander Giverese...\nwait, could it be?

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Yes, I'm talking about
General Givel, the man from
Baschen who claims to be the
"Messenger of Daftes."

<font color=blue>Welch</font> Since when did we
decide to go see a guy like
that?! Nobody mentioned that
part!
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> You're right. It wasn't\ndirect, but the masked man\ntold us to do so.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Huh!? What are you two\neven talking about!?
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Karlyn's capture was\nannounced publicly.
Naturally, this Commander\nGiverese must be aware of\nthat fact.
After all, the capture of the\nfamous Karlyn is a major event.
Giverese knows that Rubarika\nwould not make such a bold\nclaim without any evidence.

In other words, we must
assume that the fact that
Karlyn was captured by an
enemy nation has reached the
leadership of Baschen.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> In that situation, if
Karlyn tells us to go to
Baschen, there's only one thing
we can do.
We bring along important\nprisoners to make up for the\nmistake of being captured.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> What!? Important\nprisoners!? Us!?
I hate to say this myself, but\nhow exactly are we important!
<font color=blue>Verda</font> You are important.\nEspecially Euwin and Evelysse.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: <font color=blue>Euwin</font> Well, regardless of the\ncircumstances, I am still a\nmember of the Rakstar family.

As for Evelysse, the fact that she
likely possesses power similar
to the Beast Witch's
summoning symbol arts could
be what piques their interest.

en: <font color=blue>Karlyn</font> That's more or less\ncorrect.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> ...!
<font color=blue>Verda</font> You were listening? Are\nthe villagers alright now?
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Yes. Everyone is at\nease now.
Now, young lady. Ewin Laxter\nand Evelysse's symbol arts are\nimportant, of course, but...
I consider you a rather\nimportant prisoner as well.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> What!?
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> In fact, you might be the\nmost important of all.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> W-what do you mean by\nthat?
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> If you want to know,\nfirst help us reunite with\nBaschen's stationed army.
And don't forget what that\nmasked man said.
If you try to run away from me,\nit seems this collar will explode.
I don't know how big of an\nexplosion it will be,

but if you don't want the
civilians of Korurine to be
caught in the crossfire, don't
get any funny ideas.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> ...
<font color=blue>Tika</font> This bed is so fluffy!!
<font color=blue>Verda</font> We are being treated far\nbetter than I expected.

I suspect we've been given
rooms that are vastly superior
to those of the Baschen army
soldiers stationed here.
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> I wonder if that's because\nthey view us as that\nimportant...

Coro, Rekoro, what do you\nthink?
<font color=blue>Coro</font> "...Ah, am I allowed to\nspeak now?"

<font color=blue>Verda</font> You did well to hold
back your communications
after we left the Rubarika
dungeons. Good job!

Hmm... it's just, that man in the\nmask..."

masked man knew we were
going to do this from the very
beginning...

<font color=blue>Coro</font> "And that's why I don't
think they're treating you well
just to keep you from
escaping.

Korurine seems like a small
village, but perhaps because
it's near the border, there are
over 2,000 soldiers stationed
around the area,

Karlyn's summoning arts were

think about it.

existing technology or
something derived from the
power of the "Emissaries,"

Baschen possess technology

hard to believe a soldier of
Karlyn Kayson's caliber

take the chance to make a run
for it.

And it doesn't seem like Big
Brother Euwin plans to run
either.
Which is why...
Hm?
Huh?
S-something feels strange.
Why aren't we running away?
I... I wonder why that is.
I want to uncover the secrets\nof Summoning Symbolism.
For Euwin and the others.
In search of new bananas.

because we want to learn more

Evelysse doesn't\nremember where she learned\nSummoning Symbolism, right?

to know. Karlyn said she was
granted the power of
summoning by someone.
I suspect it was that person\nnamed Givel, the "Servant of\nDaftes."
If that's the case, then he...
He knows the true nature of\nthis power...
I want to meet the person who\nknows the truth about this\npower.

Euwin laughed when I first
mentioned it, but I never
imagined it would come to pass

If I run away now, it'll only\ncause trouble for Euwin and\nWelch.

After all, they're running away\nfrom Rubarika,

so if things stay like this, Big

Welch hates Baschen because\nshe suffered great losses\nduring the Holy War,

That's the one thing we can't\ndo!
Big Brother Euwin and Big\nSister Welch call Daftine and\nRubarika home.
We can't make them abandon\ntheir homes just for our own\nconvenience. Absolutely not.
Tika...
This is a mission of the utmost\nimportance, Captain! Please\nhandle this!

Captain... have you actually lost
the ability to read the room
while pretending to be a
ventriloquist?
Consider the time and place.
Exactly as the Captain says!\nBananas are an ultra-luxury\nitem on Daftine!
No matter the situation, the\njoy of eating must be secured\nat the very least!

It has been scientifically
proven through data that
meals have an extremely large
impact on mission success!
Even so...
Our most important mission is\nto return Tika to her home,
but there's no rule saying we\ncan't enjoy the things we\nencounter along the way!
Now! Tika, come eat a banana\nwith us!
Tika! It's a banana! Tika! It's a\nbananaaaa!
Coro... you're kind of scaring\nme...?
Captain. Once we return to the\nship,

I request that AI Coro be
uninstalled down to the last
byte, and its physical chassis
be decomposed at a molecular
level.
I'm so sorry! I am truly sorry\nfor Coro's behavior! I'll give him\na good thrashing later!!
Aaaaah!!
Regardless... it means we have\na reason to stay here for now.
Yes, for Tika's sake, and for\nEuwin and Welch, running away\nis not an option for us!
Let them bring on whatever\ntraps they have!

If Tika and the others are
causing time regression, then
as a member of the Galactic
Federation Army, it is my duty

and thanks to Karlyn, I'm

Oh.
U-Welch?
...I heard there's a carriage\nleaving for the <font color=yellow>Imperial Capital\nof Baschen</font> tomorrow night.
I-I see...
Anyway, I'm going to bed.
...Now, if I'm not mistaken,\nsomething must have\nhappened.
Welch and Karlyn don't seem\nlike they'd get along very well.

...That's Welch at her absolute
worst. I think no matter what
you ask her now, she'll just
stay silent.
I'll find a good time tomorrow\nto figure out what happened.

Ladies, sorry, but if she starts
thrashing around and punching
her pillow tonight, please just
ignore her.
Well, easier said than done...

Oh boy.

Big sister Welch...? I wonder\nwhat's wrong.

knowing that skilled users like

makes for excellent training.

Symbol Arts targeting you from

The rest will be treated as
hostages here, so you know
what happens if you try
anything funny.

...What are you talking about?\nI'd appreciate it if you'd stop\nmaking baseless accusations.
The fact that you snap back\nso quickly suggests you're well\naware of it.

If it looked like we were
slacking off, maybe it's just
because Baschen's army is too
weak?
...I see. In that case, for the\nnext training session, I'll have\nyou face them one by one.

What...!

It's embarrassing that my
troops are such weaklings. To
ensure our guests from
Rubarika are satisfied, I can't
afford to be picky about my
methods, right?
...You... you vixen!!

As I told you last night, I
personally hold you in the
highest regard.
Know your place and obey my\ndemands without hesitation.
...Welch, what is going on?
Shut up, Eu!
I... I'm not listening to a word\nthat woman says...!
If you do as I say, your wishes\ncan be granted...

Shut your mouth!

W-wait! That's completely\nreckless!
Please! If you do that, Big\nSister Welch will die!
We'll do our best to fight!
You guys... I can't believe\nyou're bowing your heads to\npeople like this!

...How tedious. You can just
stand there and do nothing
while your comrades bow to
the enemy?
...Eu... Tika... Captain.
Get out of the way.
Hey!
Big sister Welch! Stop it!
Fine by me. Let's do this.
Instead, why don't you come\ndown here, Beast Witch?
Your soldiers and beasts are\nsuch weaklings that it's not\neven a challenge.
If you want data, then come at\nme one-on-one, you brat!!
Cheap provocation.
But I'll play along.

I'll remind you of the memory
from just a few days ago, when
you begged for your life with a
trembling voice.
Eek!
Wait! This is supposed to be\ntraining!
Exactly! We're giving it our all\nhere!

Hmph! You call yourself the
Beast Witch, but you're just
relying on Baschen's beastly
power!
The proof is that we won in the\nRoyal Capital!
He can't summon the beast\nright now! Which means I can\ntake you on!!
Lately, even Baschen has been\ntoo afraid of me to deal with\nme.
I've been waiting for someone\nwith a bit of spirit to show up...!
W-wait a minute!
Prisoners should stay quiet!
No, listen! I hear a strange\nnoise...!!
Huh?
What is it!?
He can't summon any beasts\nright now! Which means I can\ntake him on too!!
Lately, even Baschen has been\nafraid of me, and no one will\ntalk to me.
I've been waiting for someone\nwith that kind of spirit to show\nup...!
Huh?
What's going on!?
Attack! We're\nunder attack!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Baschen Soldier: "

en: What's happening?!

An attack
from the Rubarika side!
Approximately 2,000 troops!
There are many <font color=yellow>Light Arrow
Soldiers</font> among them!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Baschen Soldier: "

en:
Light Arrow Soldiers? You
mean soldiers using the same
light arrows as the
messenger?!

This has become a nuisance.
It's a bit earlier than planned,
but I'll transport these people
to the Imperial Capital.
Their objective is likely\nRakstar's fifth son. Hurry!
Yes, ma'am!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Baschen Soldier: "

en: I'm the objective...?
No way!
You seem to be a bit sharper\nthan your father or your\nbrothers.
For now, training is cancelled.\nWe are evacuating Korurine.\nHurry!
I-I'm trying, but...
Y-you've gotta be kidding! I'm\nnot taking orders from you\npeople any longer!
We're escaping toward\nRubarika!
You can't!
You can't!
W-what!? Even you, Eu! What\nare you talking about?
Sure, we're prison escapees,\nbut it's gotta be better than\nstaying here...!
That's not the point! Look over\nthere!!
Huh...?
Gwaaaaaaaah!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Village Youth: "

en:
Retreat!
Retreat! Prioritize protecting
the villagers! Get to the
shelters! There are Light
Archers here!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Baschen Soldier: "

en: H-help me!\nAhhh!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Village Woman: "

en: What... what is that...
I... I can't go any\nfurther. Just run, quickly...!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Village Elder: "

en: What are you\nsaying?! Get up, now! The\nRubarika soldiers will kill us!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Elder's Daughter: "

en: What are they doing... what on\nearth are they doing...
Welch! We have to get out of\nhere!
Why... why do we have to run...
Why... why are they doing this!
Nuuuaaaagh!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Village Elder: "

en: Father!\nFather!! Nooooo!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Elder's Daughter: "

en: No... I don't\nwant to die...!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Village Woman: "

en: Lady Karlyn!\nHurry! We can't hold them off\nmuch longer!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Baschen Soldier: "

en: We have to run... we have to\nget out of here, Welch!
I won't... I can't just let them\nget away with this...
Eu, how can you just stand\nthere! Look at them! Look at\nthe emblems they're carrying!!
Welch...!!
Those are the emblems of\nHouse Rakstar...
Those are Carlone's soldiers!!
This is bad! More light arrows\nare flying our way! We must\nhurry!
Calculating distance to the\nBaschen military carriage!\nPrioritize Tika's evacuation!

Honestly... if that girl hadn't
been hesitating, we wouldn't be
scrambling like this just to
retreat.

The carriage is this way! It's
time you stopped the foolish
notion that the people of your
homeland fight with reason!
Kill them!\nBurn the entire village and the\ngarrison to the ground!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Rubarika Soldier: "

en: Not the village...!\nMy house! Nooooo!!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Village Man: "

en: You've got to be kidding me...\nThis is... What are... you\npeople...
What the hell do you think\nyou're doing!!!
<font color=blue>Villager</font> Aaaah! Aaaaah! Help!\nSomebody help me!!
<font color=blue>Rubarika Soldier</font> Get out of the\nway!!
<font color=blue>Villager</font> Agh... No... stop...
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Stop it! Stop it! This\ncan't be happening!!
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Evelysse! Tika! Get Welch to\nsafety! Captain, Verda, please\nprovide cover!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: <font color=blue>Verda</font> Honestly! I'm just a child\nmyself, you know!
<font color=blue>Coro</font> "Multiple Rubarika soldiers\narmed with light arrows\napproaching! Maximum alert!"
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Stop it! Please stop it!!
Thanks to you all, their\noffensive is slowing down. I\nthink we can make our escape.

Eu... you... your opponents are
soldiers from Rubarika... from
Carlone... from our own
homeland!
And yet, look at what you've\ndone...!
I know! I know it all too well!!
I've traveled all over the world.\nI've seen plenty of things far\nworse than this!
And because I saw them, I\ndared to dream.
But dreams...
Dreams only exist beyond\nreality!
That's why... I can't afford to\ndie in a place like this!
You're not\ngetting away!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Rubarika Soldier: "

en: I... I am from Rubarika!!

Lady
Karlyn! Please use that
carriage over there! I'll hold
them off here, so please
retreat quickly!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Karlyn's Subordinate: "

en: I understand. Prioritize the\nevacuation of the residents\nover maintaining the garrison.
Understood!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Karlyn's Subordinate: "

en: Swaying light, obey me!!
My\nbeasts will protect the people\nof Korurine! Hurry!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Karlyn's Subordinate: "

en: I'm counting on you!
Let's go, you two!
Yes!
Welch! Get up!!
No... this isn't right...
Damn it...
Tika! Can you use that\ncontraption to carry Welch to\nthe carriage!?
Leave it to me!
Sorry, Welch!! Rekoro, let's go!
Welch Vineyard transport\nmission! Power Arm, maximum\noutput!!
Tika... stop, let me go, this is a\nlie, this... this can't be\nhappening...
...Perhaps that was a bit too\nmuch of a shock to bring her\nback to reality...
Everyone's here! Let's move\nout!!
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> We should be safe for\nnow. We need to let the horses\nrest a bit.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> ...
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> ...
<font color=blue>Verda</font> ...
<font color=blue>Tika</font> ...
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> This is... just terrible.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: <font color=blue>Verda</font> Yeah... it's the first time\nI've seen the true reality of the\nHoly War...
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> I'm relieved that you two\nare more mature than she is.

We had a bit of a commotion,
but we'll head straight for the
Imperial Capital now to deliver
the message. It'll be a grueling
journey, so please hang in
there.
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> Still, I can't believe Welch\nlost her composure like that...
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: She's been acting strange\nsince last night. What on earth\ndid you say to her?
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> It was nothing major.

I just realized that her wish
was to stop any more
casualties in the Holy War, so I
simply suggested an idea to
make that wish come true.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> An idea to stop the\ncasualties, you say?

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Yes. Apparently, she's
the one who created that
strange hammer and Ewin
Laxter's sword.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> ...Well, that seems to be\nthe case.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Personality aside, her\ntechnical skill is top-notch.

So, I suggested that she join
the Weapon Development
Bureau of the Baschen Imperial
Capital to use that power to
bring peace to the world.
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> H-how on earth does that\nlead to world peace?!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> She had the exact same
reaction. She told me she
couldn't possibly cooperate
with Baschen, and that she's a
citizen of Rubarika!

Though... it'll be interesting to
see if she can still talk that big
after seeing what the soldiers
of her homeland have done
with her own eyes.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> ...!
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Right now, the Baschen\narmy is being pushed back.

The cause is those light arrows
used by the messengers.
Weapons that can easily pierce
steel plates without any real
training are a serious threat.

Meanwhile, all we have are
traditional crest arts and the
"Beasts," whose numbers are
limited.
But... I wonder what would\nhappen if weapons created by\nher were added to our arsenal.

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> That's the idea. If we
overrun the battlefield with
innovative military power,
everyone will fear that
strength, and no one will ever
dare to fight again.

<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> Overrun the battlefield?
Can you really call a world
trembling in fear of military
might "peaceful"?!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Please spare me the
tired sophistry. Humans are
creatures who shout and throw
punches when they have
nothing else.

This war has gone on so long
that we no longer know when it
started or why the
Moonshadow Ladders and
Daftes' messengers began to
appear. To end it,

one side must utterly crush
the other with overwhelming
power, using the memory of
that terror to suppress any
future conflict.

If there is another way, I would
love for you to tell me,
complete with specific
procedures and strategies.
Usually, the empty-headed\ndreamers just start saying, "We\nshould just talk it out."
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> ...Even so, we can't just\njustify war.

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Of course not. That's
why we need a final resolution
with such great power that
neither side ever thinks of
fighting again.

If Baschen provides full
support for her technology, I'm
certain that will become
possible.

For the past four years,
Rubarika has relied too heavily
on the power of the light
arrows, neglecting the training
of individual soldiers.

If the elite soldiers of Baschen
are equipped with her
weapons―weapons equal to
the light arrows...
Rubarika won't stand a chance.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> (...No matter the planet,\npeople never seem to change...)
I... I can't believe I'd use my\npower for something like that...!

Oh? Then what would you have
done if the Kingdom of
Rubarika had asked for the
same thing?

I'd want to show them that
with my inventions, they don't
even need the 'Power of the
Messenger'!
The reason you're brooding like\nthis right now...

...is because Rubarika is no
longer the absolute good, and
Baschen is no longer the
absolute evil, isn't it?
Why don't you stop pretending\nto be so conflicted?
You intended to do the exact\nsame thing from the start.

To kill the strangers of
Baschen, simply because you
decided they were absolute
evil.
...No... that's not... I didn't...
That's enough.
Oh?
Stop it. I won't let you go any\nfurther.
...You're surprisingly soft.
Is it because of her? Or is that\njust your nature?
...Uuuugh...
...Fine, fine. My apologies. I may\nhave teased you a bit too\nmuch...
But still...
I'm amazed you'd even think of\ngetting involved in the Holy\nWar with such naive ideas.
I'll never be able to understand\npeople like you.
Big sister Welch... please, just\neat something...

Welch. We arrive at the
Imperial Capital tomorrow. You
need to eat to keep your
strength up, or you'll be in
trouble if something happens...
It's no use. I've never seen\nWelch in this state before.
I don't know what to do...
Euwin... I have an idea.
Verda?

I have already received
Karlyn's permission. Could you
leave me alone with the
Captain and Welch for a while?
Now then, Welch.
I have a proposal for you.

Truth be told, we on the
"Coro's Ship" have a little trick
for making even the "Power of
the Messenger" flee in terror.
Welch. If this is becoming too\nmuch for you, getting off here\nis an option.

If continuing this journey is too
much for you, Welch... I can
have Carlone send you back
right away.
Just leave it to me, Captain.
Besides, the pretext of wanting\nto inspect Tika's and my\nweaponry...
Now that we couldn't refute\nKarlyn's point, it's nothing more\nthan a shackle for Welch.
We shall be the ones to bow\nour heads to Karlyn.
You had no intention of\ncooperating with Baschen to\nbegin with, did you?
Unlike Euwin, Welch cannot be\nused as a hostage against\nRubarika.
To put it bluntly, we wouldn't\nbe hindered if Welch were to\nleave us now.
...You didn't have to say it like\nthat.
It is the truth.
What about the Captain?
Do you feel the same way,\nCaptain?

Suddenly getting all serious...
You should use your usual
ventriloquism at times like this.
Lighten the mood a bit.
So, what will it be?

If Welch wishes to return to
Carlone, well, that is fine. If the
others look the other way, I
can have you sent back in a
minute or two.
What about that vixen? Even if\nI apologize, there's still the\nbomb on the collar.

I believe that can be handled
with a bit of research. If I offer
to remove the collar, I doubt
Karlyn would refuse.
After all, we have fought side\nby side for quite some time.
...You people are weird. What is\nwrong with you... Just weird.
Well, we are a bit strange.
I know that...
...Say, Welch.

I, too, have chased grand
ambitions, wandered aimlessly,
hit walls, and fallen into despair
more times than I can count.
I've thought this for a while,\nbut you're really not childlike at\nall, Verda.
I must admit, I've lived a hard\nlife.

I've made countless irreparable
blunders, and I can't tell you
how many times I've wailed,
wondering why I was wasting
my time on such useless
things.
But in those moments,\nsomething always came to\nmind.
The faces of my precious\nfamily.
This was long before I met the\nCaptain and the others.
I had a beloved family that I\nhad been separated from.

Even though I hadn't seen them
for years, just picturing their
faces would naturally quiet the
turmoil in my heart.
Even though the situation\nhadn't improved one bit. It was\na strange thing.

...I have no evidence to
disprove what Karlyn says. And
I imagine you feel the same,
Welch.

But, Welch, if there is someone
precious to you among those
responsible for what happened
to you...

Couldn't you try your best...
just so that precious person
doesn't have to shed any more
tears?
...Cheeky.
I get that a lot.
...Sigh... This is ridiculous.
I can't believe... I'm being told\nthis by a child like you, Verda.
Nyahihishi... Frustrating, isn't\nit?
...It really is.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> It'll be fine! I promise I'll\nfind him!
<font color=blue>Welch</font> But... it's impossible... We\ndon't even know where he is...
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> If we knew, we wouldn't\nhave to look. That's why I'm\nsearching!
Welch stopped smiling after\nher father disappeared.
That's why I'm going to find\nhim!
<font color=blue>Welch</font> But Euwin... what if\nsomething happens to you...
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> I'll be okay. This Holy\nWar is already over!
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Besides, I'm training with\nthe sword now!
Look at this! I took it from my\nbrother's room, and a sword\nthis size is already...
Ah, w-waaaah!
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Are you okay!?
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Ouch...
O-oh, forget that! I'm usually\nfine!
That's weird. This shouldn't be\nhappening... huh?
<font color=blue>Welch</font> ...That sword is just too\nbig for you, Euwin.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> T-that's not true! I\nusually train with swords even\nbigger than this!

<font color=blue>Welch</font> You and your brother
are different sizes, Euwin. You
won't be able to get stronger
unless you use a sword that
actually fits you.
You're not actually allowed to\ntrain with swords yet, are you?
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> ...Ugh...
<font color=blue>Welch</font> ...Hey, Euwin. Will you\nreally go look for my father\nsomeday?
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> I-I'll go right now if you\nwant!
<font color=blue>Welch</font> In that case, I'll make a\nsword for you, Euwin!
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> What?

<font color=blue>Welch</font> My mom is reopening
the shop. I learned a lot from
my dad, so I can handle a bit
of blacksmithing too.
So... if you're really going to go\nlook for my father, Euwin...
I want you to take a sword I\nmade and be the first to tell\nhim that I'm doing well.
So... until I'm able to make that\nsword, will you promise to get\nstronger?
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> ...O-okay! In exchange,\nmake sure it's just as cool as\nmy brother's!
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Yeah. I promise!
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Yay! It's a promise! I'll\ndefinitely be strong by then!
...A promise, huh.
Hm?
...Hey, Verda, Captain. There's\nsomething I have to do.
Mmu.
Neither the double blade nor\nthe hammer are my own\noriginals.

That means I haven't fulfilled
my promise yet, and I don't
have the strength that woman
expects of me.
But if I go back to Carlone\nnow, I'll probably never be able\nto keep that promise.
Please. Let me travel with\neveryone a little longer...
I might still be unable to look\nthat woman straight in the\neye...
But I'm going to make a proper\ncomeback.
Hmm. Is that alright, Captain?
...Thank you. From now on...
From now on, please take good\ncare of the genius, beautiful,\nyoung inventor, Welch!!
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> I never imagined I'd\nactually end up coming to the\nImperial Capital of Baschen.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> What a huge castle! I\nwonder if it's bigger than\nRubarika Castle.

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> By rough estimation,
the total floor area of the
<font color=yellow>Baschen Imperial Castle</font> is
approximately 1.4 times that of
Rubarika Castle.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> ...You say such oddly\nprecise things in such a\nstrange voice.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> O-oh, is that so? Wow!!
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> Tika... you've really gotten\nthe hang of playing along...
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
<font color=blue>Verda</font> This may not be my
place to say, but Karlyn, are
you sure it's alright to enter
the castle while wearing that
collar?
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Oh, this?
True. He did say it would\nexplode, but I'm not particularly\nworried about it.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> I assume they intend to\nbring us before the\nCommander-in-Chief, right?
I expected we'd be disarmed\nbefore even entering the\ncapital.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> You shouldn't\nunderestimate Lord Givel.
The Commander-in-Chief is a\n"Messenger of Daftes" and the\ngreatest symbolist in Baschen.

I already sent a letter by
express horse when we arrived
in Korurine to explain my
situation and this collar. I
included the matter of that
masked man as well.

Even if this collar were to
explode right in front of Lord
Givel, he wouldn't suffer a
single scratch.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> ...He sounds like a\nformidable opponent to cross.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> I've heard that the
current Emperor of Baschen is
a warrior who commanded the
front lines of the Holy War
during his time as Crown
Prince, fighting with both
weapons and arts.

He likely has absolute
confidence that no matter
what happens, he cannot be
assassinated.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> ...You all said you wanted
to meet General Givel, but what
exactly do you plan to do once
you do?
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> First, I'm going to talk to\nhim.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> You plan to talk him into
stopping the war? Just so you
know, Commander-in-Chief
Givel―and of course, His
Majesty the Emperor―are
hardline hawks.
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> That's not it. It's about\nyour power as the "Beast\nWitch."
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
I want to know how you
obtained a power that is the
spitting image of my own
symbol arts, and how you're
able to grant it to others... if I
can get an answer.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Ah, now that you\nmention it, your symbol arts\nare very similar to mine.
Don't you even know the true\nnature of your own power?
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font>: There's no point in hiding\nit. You're right.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Baschen's Commander-in-Chief\nis a vital hint for me in\nsearching for my roots.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font>: Looking at it that way,\nit seems we're both of use to\none another.

Just as much as her hammer
and double-bladed sword, I'm
interested in your symbol arts.
I'm sure Lord Givel would be
interested as well.
If possible, I'd like for us to get\nalong.
<font color=blue>Welch</font>: ...No matter how many\ntimes you ask, I'm not\ncooperating.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font>: Hehe, that's right.
Either way, you won't be\nreturning to Rubarika so easily.\nWe have plenty of time.
You might just change your\nmind eventually.
Now then, we've arrived.
Karlyn Kayson has returned.

Ah, you've returned. I
was concerned when I heard
you had been captured by
Rubarika.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en:
...I am unworthy of such
kindness. That Your Majesty
would personally worry for
someone like me, a <font color=yellow>Kodama</font>...
What are you saying?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en:
As long as you are
useful to me and Baschen, I
make no distinction regarding
your nature as a Kodama.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en: I hear you threw the\ncapital of Rubarika into chaos\nand captured Carlone's nobles.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en: In the face of such\nmilitary achievement, being a\nKodama is a trivial matter.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en: Yes, Your Majesty.

Even Givel was
praising the fact that you
escaped and shamed Rubarika,
rather than the fact that you
were captured.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en: He should be coming\nup here shortly...
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en: And those behind\nyou, are they the prisoners?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en: It is as you say, Your Majesty.

Hmm. I see. Even
among barbarians like those in
Rubarika, the nobility certainly
possess a certain air of
refinement.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en: ...Maybe I should show him how\na real barbarian behaves.
H-hey, Welch!
Your Majesty, you are far too\ncareless.
Ah, my\nCommander-in-Chief! I have\nbeen waiting for you!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en: ...It is good to see you are well,\nKarlyn Kayson.
Yes, sir!
Let us get straight to it. Are\nthose behind you the prisoners\nmentioned in the report?
That is correct, sir.

Hmm. At a glance, they all look
young. They hardly seem like
the kind of elite soldiers our
nation possesses, nor the sort
of people you would struggle to
capture...
Hm?
U-um... is something the\nmatter?

You are in the presence of His
Majesty and the
Commander-in-Chief. Do not
speak without permission.
I-I'm sorry...

Commander. This girl is the
youngest among everyone, so
she has not yet mastered
proper etiquette. Please
forgive her.
No, it is fine... Hmm, well, I\nsuppose it's impossible...
What?
Karlyn Kayson!
Huh?
Was she the one who used\nSymbolism similar to that of\nthe "Beast Witch"?!
Y-yes, that is correct...
Her name!!
D-do you mean this one? She\nis...
I wasn't asking you!!
I asked for her name! What is\nher name!!
...I can hear you just fine\nwithout you shouting.
That's hardly the way to ask a\nlady for her name.
Evelysse! Show some respect!!\nHow could you speak to the\nCommander-in-Chief...
Evelysse... Evelysse... Evelysse!!
Commander-in-Chief?
Givel... what on earth\nis the matter?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en: W-what is it...
Evelysse...
Ah, Evelysse,
I see, I see!!

Unbelievable, simply
unbelievable! No matter how
lucky I was, I thought it would
take 50,000 years!!
F-50,000 years?
Evelysse...
Ah, Evelysse!
I see, I see!!

I can't believe it, I simply can't!
No matter how lucky one is, I
thought it would take 50,000
years!!
F-fifty thousand years?

When I first received the
report, I didn't dare hope... I
assumed it was just some
victim of the ladder or
Mastima...
Hehehe, is this what they call\nthe victory of the selfless!
Listen, Evelysse!
My entire life has led up to this\nvery moment!
Evelysse! All for the sake of\nmeeting you!!
W-what is wrong with you?\nYou're creeping me out!
Evelysse!
I don't care! I don't care, I don't\ncare, I don't care! Oh, I just\ndon't care! None of it matters!
Evelysse!! Ah, you must\nunderstand!
Just how astronomical a\nmiracle it took to bring about\nthis moment!!
As long as I have you, as long\nas I have you! I have no more\nuse for this country!!
W-what are you talking\nabout...?
Kuhahahahaha!
Ah, look at this! This is the\ndestiny of the chosen!
Poor, unchosen Mastima... how\ncomical your face looked when\nyou pitied me back then!
W-what... is this...?
Something's wrong here!
G-Givel! What on\nearth have you been doing all\nthis time...!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en:
Captain! I'm detecting a
staggering amplification of Gem
power! It's on par with a Great
Magic spell!
Coro! Initiate teleportation\ncontainment! This castle is\ndangerous!!
Th-this voice...
Captain, what on earth are you\ndoing even at a time like this...!!
Preparations are already\nunderway! T-minus 3, 2...
I won't let you!!
Aaaah! Captain, Capta...!
Coro! Initiate teleportation\nrecovery! This castle is too\ndangerous!!
I'm already preparing!\nRecovery in 3, 2...
I think not!!
Eek! Captain, Cap―...!
Coro? Coro! What happened!
Teleportation recovery failed!\nSignal blockage confirmed!
Wh-what is that? Some ugly\ndoll is floating there and talking\non its own...?
That voice... could it be from\nback then? Was it not just the\nCaptain's ventriloquism?

Heh heh heh. You intended to
retreat to the ship waiting in
satellite orbit, I presume, but
that will not happen.

Not only teleportation, but
communications and scans
cannot penetrate this Imperial
Castle.
...! Could it be that this fellow...!
People from an advanced\nplanet...!
Advanced planet?
Ah, well, I suppose that's true.\nIt's not exactly wrong to put it\nthat way, but...
Hehehe, it hardly matters\nanymore!
Evelysse! At last, we meet.
All those long years I spent in\nthis star system have finally\npaid off. Now, come with me.
...No thanks.
Oh?
I have absolutely no idea what\nyou're talking about.

Who do you think you are?!
You're acting like you know me,
but I don't know your face or
your name!
E-Evelysse! Show some\nrestraint!
Wait, Karlyn! He is...
...Hold your tongue... you filthy\nfox spirit.
...Huh?
Aaaah!?
Karlyn!!
What? Givel! What\nare you doing! What on earth\nhas been going on...
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en: Ah... these fools, swarming like\ninsects in some corner of the\nuniverse...
How much longer must you\ninterfere with my pleasure...
Hmph!!
Gah!?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en:
Hey, wait a minute! W-what are
you doing! This woman and the
Emperor are your allies, aren't
they!!

Allies... you say allies? Do not
presume to speak to me, you
insect from an uncivilized
planet!!
Kyaaa!?
Welch!!
Guah!!
Welch! Euwin!!
Rekoro! Get Tika out of here!\nDo whatever it takes! Just get\nher away!
Agh!!
Sister Verda!! Everyone!!
Tika! We're leaving! There's\nnothing you can do for us here!
Wait! Rekoro, wait for me!!
I'm not waiting this time! Get as\nfar away from that thing as...
Guh!!
Kyaaa!? M-my body... I can't\nmove...!
Tika... Tika? Hmm, I thought\nshe looked familiar, but is this\nmerely a coincidence?
Tika! Rekoro!
...No, that's not it.

That Mastima... I don't know
how far her schemes go, but it
seems best to dispose of this
girl quickly.
Why... why can't I move!!
Tika! Let her go!
Evelysse... why do you care so\nmuch for such a mere insect?
Ah, perhaps there is a reason\nyour memories have been\nsealed?
My memories... sealed?
How pitiful... but fear not. With\nme by your side, you have\nnothing to worry about.
So first... I shall turn those who\nbind your heart into dust.
W-what are you...!
Heh heh heh... Dark Star!\nBecome the dark path that\nsnatches him away!!
W-what are these things... They\naren't beasts... They're on a\ncompletely different level...
*Pant... pant...* Tika, run...
Everyone...
Arms functions... severely\ndamaged... At this rate, Tika\nwill...
Coro, Coro! Is the\ncommunication still not\nrestored?!

Hmph, quite impressive for
mere insects. I suppose that's
how you managed to lead
Evelysse this far.
J-just who are you...
I suppose I can't afford to be\nlenient.

If I don't turn these wretches
to dust this instant, Evelysse
will never return... O, Dark
Star...!!
What...
Once I have you, I have no\nfurther use for this country.

The Holy War or
whatever―they can do as they
please. As a thank you for
their hospitality, I'll erase them
in a heartbeat.
L-Lord Givel! What on earth are\nyou doing?! What do you mean\nby this?!
Read the room, will you?!
He's not the commander you\nknow! Can't you tell by the\nvibe? He's completely lost it!!
Shut up!!
Lord Givel! What has happened\nto you?!
...Shall I start by erasing you?

The most gifted Summoning
Sigil adapter... How pitiful. If
Evelysse hadn't appeared, you
might have been the gateway.
Lord... Givel...
But a fake can never hope to\nmatch the real thing.
Your devotion thus far has\nbeen appreciated. Now, you\nmay rest...
Lord Givel!!
Nooooo!!
<font color=blue>Woman with a bewitching smile</font>\n...Hm?
This reaction...
Ah, finally. That took quite a\nwhile.
But now we've finally reached\nthe halfway point. It seems\nthere's still a long way to go.
<font color=blue>Woman with sorrowful eyes</font> ...?

<font color=blue>Woman with a bewitching smile</font>
Hm? You're wondering if this
was just a fleeting moment to
me?
Hehe, well, of course.

Compared to the years I've
spent until now, it's a trivial
amount of time―hardly the size
of a pinky nail.
<font color=blue>Woman with a bewitching smile</font>\nEven so, I am still "human."
My sense of waiting isn't all\nthat different from yours.

I was told the trigger would be
the invasion of the Levarance
fleet, but it's been a long time
since then.
Well, I shall wait, though I won't\nhold my breath.
...Hey, Tika Blanche.
...Ah... Captain...
Ouch...
What happened to me...?
...That's right! Givel!
Where is he?! What happened\nto him?!
What? He's not here?
More importantly... wait, where\nam I?
Please tell me his Symbolism\ndidn't turn the entire Imperial\nCapital of Baschen into this...
Wait... ah! Over there! It's Tika!
Mmm... *yawn*...
Ah... Captain... and\nRishu-oneechan too...
Evelysse! Captain!!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Rekoro! Thank goodness! What\nabout Tika!?
There is some damage to the\nArms' functions, but Tika's\nvitals are normal!
Ah! Captain, Evelysse! Thank\ngoodness! You're both safe!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Verda!
Euwin! Karlyn! Over here! The\nCaptain and the others are\nhere!
Thank goodness, you're safe!
Karlyn, can you walk?

I know this is a shock. But we
can't afford to dwell on it right
now. Please, pull yourself
together!
Just... why... how could this...
Good grief! How is it that a\nbunch of grown adults are all\nfar more fragile than I am!!
I'm just glad the Captain, Evelysse,\nand Tika are all safe.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Euwin and the others too...!
By the way, is Welch here?!
S-she's not here! What about\nyour side?
I can't find her... I've looked\neverywhere...
More importantly, where on\nearth are we?!
Captain! Can you get a signal\nthrough to Coro?!
I cannot detect AI Coro on my\ncommunication waves.
Could something have\nhappened to the ship...?
Hmm... I feel like I've seen this\nscenery somewhere before...
Tika?
And what is this round thing in\nthe first place...?

Captain, Verda, I don't
understand what you're talking
about either. Do you two
actually know what's going on?
I cannot provide a detailed\naccount of the events at the\nBaschen Imperial Castle...

However, based on calculations
performed after function
recovery, it is certain that we
are neither in Baschen nor
Rubarika.
What's that?
One incomprehensible thing\nafter another...
If General Givel isn't here, we\nneed to find Welch first! We\ncan talk after that...

Captain, Verda, I don't
understand what you're saying
either. Do you two even know
what's happening right now?
I cannot provide a detailed\naccount of the events at the\nBaschen Imperial Castle...

However, based on calculations
performed after my functions
were restored, it is certain that
we are neither in Baschen nor
Rubarika.
One confusing thing after\nanother...
If General Givel isn't here, we\nneed to find Welch first! We\ncan talk after that...
Now what?!
It's coming from that strange\nforest over there!
...Eeeeeeek!!
That voice!
Heeeeelp meeeeeeeee!!
Welch!
Thank goodness! You're safe!
Ah! Eu! Evelysse! Help meeeee!!! I'm\ngonna be killed!!!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Well... it seems.
She has brought along some\ntruly terrible companions!

They are a swarm of lifeforms
identical to the "Baschen's
Beasts" summoned by Karlyn
Kayson!! There are werewolf
types mixed in as well!
...What?
Waaaaah, thank goodness! I'm\nso happy to see people I know,\neven if it's a woman like her!!

When I woke up, I was
surrounded by those things!
I've been running for my life
through the forest this whole
time!!

...No, something is strange...
those creatures haven't been
Thornite-ized! They are just
ordinary beasts!
It doesn't look like they're going\nto let us go!
Jeez! What on earth is going\non here!!
<font color=blue>Welch</font> There's still more of\nthem!! Hey, fox-girl! Do\nsomething about this!
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> M-my control doesn't\nwork on these things!

<font color=blue>Welch</font> Then what about your
summons! I don't know why, but
they don't have collars
anymore!
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> I've been trying this\nwhole time! I can't! It won't\nactivate!
<font color=blue>Welch</font> You're useless when it\nactually counts! Just get out\nof the way!

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Don't underestimate me!
Even if I can't summon beasts,
I am a warrior of the Fox Soul
and a soldier of Baschen!
A-Arms! Rekoro!

Both the legs and arms are
damaged! They were already at
their limit after the battle at
the Imperial Castle!
Hanyah!? The gun's energy is\nalmost gone!
Just how many of these things\nare there...?!

It's like there are dozens of
Beast Witches out here! What
are we going to do! We can't
escape in a wide-open plain like
this!
Why! Why won't the summoning\ncrest activate!
Captain! At this rate, we're\ndoomed!
...Nun!
...Nuhn!
Wh...
What... was that?
One thing after another! I can't\nmake any sense of this!!
Ah, there's someone over\nthere!
Wh-who goes there!!
My apologies, I did not intend\nto startle you.

I detected that you were being
attacked by the native
creatures of this planet and
rushed to your aid. I harbor no
ill will toward you.
Wh-what's with that person...\nthere are strange things all\nover their body...
A robot... no, a Cyborg?
...Hmm... four Daftine, one\nLevarance... and...
And...
I am amazed. Could it be that\nyou are a Terran?

W-who are you? How do you
know the Captain is a Terran...
and how do you even know
about Earth in the first place?
It is impossible to mistake the\nDNA of a Terran.

Especially one from the home
planet of the great friend who
once set the blood in my
father's frozen body ablaze.
If you wouldn't mind, could you\ntell me your name?
...<player>... Mista <player>.
note: term (en-prefix 2026-10-08, english.md 7.21): ミスタ Mista

en:
I never imagined I would
encounter a Terran at the far
reaches of the galaxy. I am
trembling with unexpected joy.
I have no idea what is going on\nhere...
Oh, my apologies, young lady.

It seems I let myself get
carried away by the
unexpected turn of events and
lost my composure.
He doesn't seem like a bad\nperson, but he's definitely\nweird...
I have absolutely no idea\nwhat's happening anymore.
I've never been this completely\nclueless in my entire life!
It is only natural for you to be\nconfused, Mista.
The only thing I can tell Mista\nright now is that this is not the\nplanet Daftine.
...What? What do you mean,\nthis isn't Daftine?
Who are you, and where on\nearth are we?
This is Daftine's twin star. It is\nthe planet known to the people\nof Daftine as <font color=yellow>Daftes</font>.
Huh!?
What...
Daftes... you say?
...I knew it.

As for myself, I have remained
here on Daftes for about a
year, observing the anomalies
attacking the Daft star system.
My name is <font color=yellow>Valka S90</font>. I am a\nwarrior of <font color=yellow>Morphus</font>.
Morphus...?
We shall discuss the details at\nmy base. You all seem\nexhausted and confused.
My base is hardly what I would\ncall comfortable, but it can\nprovide you with healing. Come.
Captain, are we really going?
We have little other choice at\nthe moment.

If the owner of that body has a
base, they surely possess
advanced planetary technology.
They should be able to fix
Tika's Arms.
...Besides.
We must get answers to\neveryone's questions.
